title: Create image API endpoints and register router in app
description:
Create chatbot/api/images.py with FastAPI endpoints for image generation, understanding, retrieval, appearance management, and outfit management. Then modify chatbot/api/app.py to register the images router.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/visual/generation.py (created by task b.4 — ImageGenerationService API)
- chatbot/visual/understanding.py (created by task b.5 — ImageUnderstandingService API)
- chatbot/visual/appearance.py (created by task b.2 — AppearanceManager, OutfitManager)
- chatbot/db/models.py (updated by task b.3 — ImageMemory, Appearance, OutfitRecord models)
- chatbot/api/app.py (existing FastAPI app, understand router registration pattern, import conventions, and existing include_router calls)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/images.py and chatbot/api/app.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

--- chatbot/api/images.py ---

1. Module docstring: 'Image API endpoints for generation, understanding, retrieval, appearance management, and outfit management.'

2. A FastAPI APIRouter instance named `images_router` with prefix '/images' and tag 'images'.

3. Pydantic models:
   - `ImageGenerateRequest`: scene_description (str, min_length=1), width (int, default=512, ge=64, le=2048), height (int, default=512, ge=64, le=2048), negative_prompt (str | None, default=None), seed (int | None, default=None).
   - `ImageGenerateResponse`: image_id (str), image_url (str), mime_type (str), seed_used (int), prompt_used (str), width (int), height (int), generation_time_ms (float).
   - `ImageUnderstandResponse`: image_id (str), description (str), detected_objects (list[str]), detected_text (str | None), scene_category (str | None), confidence (float), processing_time_ms (float).
   - `ImageView`: image_id (str), source_type (str), image_url (str), mime_type (str), prompt_used (str | None), description (str | None), width (int | None), height (int | None), created_at (str).
   - `ImageListResponse`: images (list[ImageView]), total (int).
   - `AppearanceResponse`: character_seed (int), character_description (str), visual_traits (list[str]), art_style (str), color_palette (list[str]), created_at (str), updated_at (str | None).
   - `AppearanceUpdateRequest`: character_description (str | None, default=None), visual_traits (list[str] | None, default=None), art_style (str | None, default=None), color_palette (list[str] | None, default=None). At least one field must be non-None.
   - `SeedLockRequest`: seed (int).
   - `OutfitResponse`: outfit_id (str), name (str), description (str), visual_tags (list[str]), is_active (bool), created_at (str).
   - `OutfitCreateRequest`: name (str, min_length=1, max_length=128), description (str), visual_tags (list[str]).
   - `OutfitListResponse`: outfits (list[OutfitResponse]).

4. Endpoints:
   - `POST /generate`: accepts ImageGenerateRequest JSON body plus session_id as a query param. Uses ImageGenerationService to generate and persist. Returns ImageGenerateResponse.
   - `POST /understand`: accepts a multipart UploadFile (required) plus question (optional form field) and session_id (query param). Reads file bytes and mime type, calls ImageUnderstandingService. Returns ImageUnderstandResponse.
   - `GET /{image_id}`: returns ImageView for a single image, 404 if not found.
   - `GET /`: lists images, accepts session_id, offset (default 0), limit (default 20) query params. Returns ImageListResponse.
   - `GET /appearance/{companion_id}`: returns the AppearanceResponse for a companion. Creates default if none exists.
   - `PATCH /appearance/{companion_id}`: updates appearance fields. Only updates fields present in the request body.
   - `PUT /appearance/{companion_id}/seed`: locks the character seed.
   - `GET /outfits/{appearance_id}`: lists outfits for an appearance.
   - `POST /outfits/{appearance_id}`: creates a new outfit.
   - `PUT /outfits/{appearance_id}/{outfit_id}/activate`: activates an outfit.

--- chatbot/api/app.py ---

5. Open chatbot/api/app.py and locate the existing `app.include_router(...)` calls. 

6. Import images_router from chatbot.api.images.

7. Add `app.include_router(images_router)` following the existing convention.

8. Do NOT create a new FastAPI instance, change the app variable name, modify other router registrations, or add middleware.
